sn22.47:1.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā anekavihitam attānam samanupassamānā samanupassanti || sabbe te pañcupādānakkhandhe samanupassanti etesaṃ vā aññataraṃ || || 4
sn22.47:1.4: Idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānam adassāvī || la || sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.47:1.5: rūpam attato samanupassati || rūpavantam vā attānam attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ ||
sn22.47:1.9: Viññāṇam attato samanupassati || viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā viññāṇam viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānam || ||
sn22.47:2.1: Iti ayaṃ ceva samanupassanā Asmīti cassa adhigataṃ hoti || || 5
sn22.47:2.2: Asmīti kho pana bhikkhave adhigate atha pañcannam indriyānam avakkanti hoti ||
sn22.47:2.4: Atthi bhikkhave mano atthi dhammā atthi vijjādhātu ||
sn22.47:2.5: avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave vedayitena puṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa Asmīti pissa hoti ||
sn22.47:3.1: Tiṭṭhanti kho pana bhikkhave tattheva pañcindriyāni || ||
sn22.47:3.2: Athettha sutavato ariyasāvakassa avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjati || ||
sn22.47:3.3: Tassa avijjāvirāgā vijjuppādā Asmīti pissa na hoti ||
sn22.47:3.4: Ayam aham asmīti pissa na hoti ||
